verdict.summary: Round 1's blocking fixture-guard defect is fixed: the checked suite directory now contains only the lowercase prose "known-failing", while the guard searches for the exact uppercase sentinel, so the checked-in manifest no longer self-triggers. The conformance runner exercises the public parse/evaluate/verify path, checks expected answers and disclosure counts, independently replays the rewritten query over each response, includes a provenance-stripping non-vacuity test, and verifies nonce mismatch rejection. The manifest and fixture guards cover all declared cases and validate referenced data. No new correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue is evident in the diff. Targeted tests could not be executed in this environment because cargo is unavailable.
